segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If one administered the oath to the witnesses «in» the name of «alef dalet, in» the name of «yod heh, in» the name of the «Almighty [Shaddai], in» the name of the Lord of «Hosts [Tzevaot], in» the name of the «Gracious and Compassionate» One, «in» the name of He Who is «Slow to Anger,» or «in» the name of He Who is «Abounding in Loving-kindness,» these witnesses are liable for taking a false oath of testimony.
